name: Scott Worland
bio: Scott Worland is Chief Technology Officer of Norm Ai, a New York company that automates regulatory compliance with AI agents. He joined Norm Ai as Head of Engineering before becoming CTO. He has 12+ years of experience building ML and AI systems across academia, government, and industry. Earlier, he was Director of Data Science at FreightWaves and a hydrologist at the U.S. Geological Survey, where he published machine learning research on streamflow prediction. He holds a PhD in engineering from Vanderbilt University and is a visiting research fellow in AI and Law at Emory University School of Law.

sessions.title: Built to Scale: Future-Proofing Your Technology Roadmap
